description: List Zendesk ticket metric records, including response times, resolution times, and assignment statistics, for analyzing ticket performance. Supports sorting and cursor-based page requests with a page size of up to 100.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for listing ticket metrics with cursor-based pagination and sorting.

page_after.description: Cursor token to fetch records after this position. Obtain from previous response's 'after_cursor'.
page_after.human_parameter_description: Cursor token from the previous page to get the next set of results.
page_after.title: Page After

page_before.description: Cursor token to fetch records before this position. Obtain from previous response's 'before_cursor'.
page_before.human_parameter_description: Cursor token from the previous page to get the previous set of results.
page_before.title: Page Before

page_size.description: Number of records per page for cursor pagination (max 100). Use this for large datasets.
page_size.human_parameter_description: How many ticket metrics records to return per page. Use up to 100; smaller numbers load faster.
page_size.title: Page Size

sort_by.description: Field to sort results by. Prefix with '-' for descending order.
sort_by.human_parameter_description: Pick the field to sort by (e.g., created_at, updated_at). Add '-' prefix for descending order.
sort_by.title: Sort By

inputSchema.title: GetTicketMetricsRequest

name: get_ticket_metrics

GetTicketMetricsResponse.description: Response containing list of ticket metrics with pagination info.

next_page.description: URL for next page of results
next_page.title: Next Page

previous_page.description: URL for previous page of results
previous_page.title: Previous Page

GetTicketMetricsResponse.title: GetTicketMetricsResponse

assigned_at.title: Assigned At

created_at.title: Created At

reopens.title: Reopens

reply_time_in_minutes.description: Time metrics for first reply in minutes
reply_time_in_minutes.title: Reply Time In Minutes

reply_time_in_seconds.description: Time metrics for reply time in seconds
reply_time_in_seconds.title: Reply Time In Seconds

requester_wait_time_in_minutes.description: Requester wait time metrics in minutes
requester_wait_time_in_minutes.title: Requester Wait Time In Minutes
